prompt: How many versions of the npm package `undici` are currently listed in the registry (the number of entries in its `versions` map)? Reply with ONLY the number.
note: Drift-prone and un-guessable. Whole-answer matching: a `contains` match would accept 1304 for a key of 304.

argv: fetch('https://registry.npmjs.org/undici').then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);return r.json()}).then(j=>{if(!j.versions||typeof j.versions!=='object')throw new Error('no versions map');console.log(Object.keys(j.versions).length)})
